rules.relief_rule: Play from the teeing ground; ball may be teed up.
Play the ball as it lies.

Play the ball as it lies (deep rough; reduced distance and spin control).

Play the ball as it lies; mark, lift and replace allowed. Putter only for the game.
Play the ball as it lies; do not ground the club. Unplayable option: 1 stroke, drop in the bunker.

Yellow penalty area: 1 stroke, drop behind the hazard on the line from the hole through the point where the ball crossed the margin (any distance back), or play from the previous spot (stroke and distance).
Red penalty area: 1 stroke, lateral relief within 2 club lengths (about 4 m) of where the ball crossed the margin, no nearer the hole; or back-on-the-line, or previous spot.
Red penalty area: play as it lies (very difficult) or take 1 stroke lateral relief within 2 club lengths (about 4 m) of where the ball crossed the margin, no nearer the hole.
Yellow penalty area: play as it lies (very difficult) or take 1 stroke and drop behind the area on the line from the hole through the point where the ball crossed the margin.
Stroke and distance: add 1 penalty stroke and replay from the previous position (tee if the previous shot was the tee shot).
